description: Compiler2 can publish one captured closure value at multiple callable surfaces when a returned closure is invoked polymorphically. Direct-target CallClosure bypasses the stored closure code pointer, but an indirect call through the same heap closure would need a runtime dispatch/thunk boundary instead of the current single boundary function pointer. Add a first-class boundary representation/codegen path that can select among published surfaces by callsite/runtime argument facts, then remove the deterministic fallback used by fz-bin.18 for direct-target-only materialization.
title: Native codegen: add dispatch boundary for polymorphic indirect closures
